newsitem.title: USA: Cuban's U.S. citizenship blocked over fingerprints.
newsitem.headline: Cuban's U.S. citizenship blocked over fingerprints.

text.p: Cuban immigrant Raul Blanco has been rejected for U.S. citizenship five times. The government's explanation -- it needed 10 of his fingerprints but had only seven on file.

The U.S. Immigration and Naturalisation Service now concedes it made a mistake in Blanco's case, the Miami Herald reported on Thursday. Blanco has only seven fingers. He lost the ring finger and tips of two others in a sugar mill accident years ago.
The clerks at the immigration office apparently neglected to read the explanation on Blanco's application: "amputated."
Blanco, 53, told the Herald he has lived in the United States for 17 years, always paid his taxes and will make a fine citizen.
